name: Shield drop
goal: Drop through a platform out of shield
why: Shielding on a platform, {char} would otherwise have to jump out of shield, or let go of the shield and wait out its release. A shield drop puts {char} in the air below the platform at once, so an aerial can follow straight out of shield.

tutorial.what: A shield drop is a drop through a platform straight out of shield. With UCF, as in this build and on Slippi, it is done by holding the control stick to the side and rolling it down into the down-diagonal notch.
tutorial.expect: Each shield is judged when {char} leaves it: a drop through the platform, a roll, a spot dodge, or a release. After misses, the coach shows your shield and the stick frame by frame.

marks.6: Frame 6: stick partway to the side, short of 0.70
marks.10: Frame 10: 4 frames later, the stick to the rim: no roll
marks.15: Frame 15: stick rolled down into the notch: through the platform

lessons.title: To the side without a roll
text: In shield, the control stick pushed to the side rolls {char} if it reaches 0.70 within 4 frames of leaving the centre. Pushed partway first, past a quarter of its reach but short of 0.70, and held there for 4 frames, it can then go all the way to the rim without a roll.
Holding the stick to the side is the first half of the shield drop: it is what keeps the next move from being a spot dodge.

marks.6: Frame 6: stick partway to the side, short of 0.70
marks.10: Frame 10: 4 frames later, the stick to the rim: no roll

lessons.title: Down into the notch
text: After 4 frames to the side, UCF stops a stick at the rim from spot dodging. Roll it down the rim into the down-diagonal notch, 45 degrees below level, and {char} drops through the platform.

Reach the notch within 6 frames of the stick passing a quarter of its reach down. {char} drops at about 42 to 52 degrees, one frame later at 38 to 40. Shallower, {char} stays in shield; deeper, or after under 4 frames to the side, {char} spot dodges.

marks.10: Frame 10: the stick at the side of the rim
marks.15: Frame 15: stick rolled down into the notch: through the platform

cues.words: Roll into the notch: shield drop

no roll.words: the stick reached 0.70 to the side within 4 frames of leaving the centre
no roll.headline: Roll
no roll.fix: Push the stick to the side in two steps: partway, short of 0.70, for 4 frames; then to the rim.

to the side.expect: The stick at the side of the rim
to the side.words: the stick did not reach the side
to the side.headline: Stick not to the side
to the side.fix: Push the stick partway to the side for 4 frames, then all the way to the rim, and hold it there.

no spot dodge.words: the stick went down past the notch, or was not held to the side for 4 frames
no spot dodge.headline: Spot dodge
no spot dodge.fix: Hold the stick to the side for 4 frames first, then stop at the down-diagonal notch, 45 degrees below level. Deeper than about 52 degrees, {char} spot dodges.

from shield.expect: Drop through the platform out of shield
from shield.words: left the shield without dropping through
from shield.headline: No shield drop
from shield.fix: Roll the stick down along the rim into the down-diagonal notch within 6 frames of it starting down. Short of about 38 degrees, or inside the rim, {char} stays in shield.

parts.name: To the side
parts.teach: Hold R or L to shield, push the stick partway to the side for 4 frames, then to the rim. {char} stays in shield, with no roll.

marks.6: Frame 6: stick partway to the side, short of 0.70
marks.10: Frame 10: 4 frames later, the stick to the rim: no roll

parts.success: Stick to the side, no roll.

coach.note: The stick may reach 0.70 to the side only 4 frames or more after it leaves the centre.

parts.name: Into the notch
parts.teach: Shield, stick to the side as before, then roll it down along the rim into the down-diagonal notch. {char} drops through the platform.

marks.10: Frame 10: the stick at the side of the rim
marks.15: Frame 15: stick rolled down into the notch: through the platform

cues.words: Roll into the notch: shield drop

mistakes.name: stick to the side at once

coach.note: In the example the stick reaches the side of the rim on frame 10 and rolls into the notch on frame 15.
